newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee weaker on dollar, firms on pound.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee weaker on dollar, firms on pound.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee was slightly weaker on the dollar but firmed against the pound on Friday, commercial banks forex dealers said.
The rupee was quoted at a mean rate of 20.2765 for one dollar on Friday from 20.2715 on Thursday. Against the pound the rupee was posted at a mean of 31.583 from 31.603 on Thursday.

Money dealers said the dollar softened in overnight international markets but this was offset by a weakening pressure which exists on the rupee owing to a shortage pressure of hard currency in commercial banks.

"The inflow of forex earnings to commercial banks is well short of the customers' (importers) requirements. Central bank's interventions are unfortunately not sufficient to erradicate this shortage," one dealer in a commercial bank said.
The dealer said the central bank intervened by selling dollars in the interbank forex market on Monday at a slightly higher rate than the prevailing interbank rate.

He added the Mauritius Sugar Syndicate also put sterling on tender sale to banks on Wednesday but both measures were seen as insufficient to fully relieve the hard currency shortage pressure in commercial banks.
